Title: Public Preview: Microsoft Azure Payment HSM Service

Body.Content:
Azure Payment HSM Service is now in public preview in East US and North Europe. Azure Payment HSM Service is a ‘BareMetal’ service delivered using Thales payShield 10K payment HSMs to provide cryptographic key operations for real-time payment transactions in the Azure cloud. 

Azure Payment HSM Service meets the most stringent security, audit compliance, low latency, and high-performance requirements by the Payment Card Industry (PCI). With this service, financial institutions and service providers can smoothly migrate their PCI workloads to Azure.

Learn more about  Azure Payment HSM Service
